description: This file contains unit tests for the Mattermost server's database configuration management, including setup, retrieval, comparison, environment override handling, file operations, and cleanup procedures.

methods.name: getDsn
methods.description: Returns the data source name, currently a simple passthrough of the source string.

methods.name: setupConfigDatabase
methods.description: Sets up the database with a given configuration and files, inserting into Configurations and ConfigurationFiles tables.

methods.name: getActualDatabaseConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the active configuration from the database, unmarshalling JSON into a *model.Config.

methods.name: assertDatabaseEqualsConfig
methods.description: Asserts that the database's active configuration matches the expected configuration.

methods.name: assertDatabaseNotEqualsConfig
methods.description: Asserts that the database's active configuration does not match the given configuration.

methods.name: newTestDatabaseStore
methods.description: Creates a new Store backed by a DatabaseStore with optional custom defaults.

methods.name: TestDatabaseStoreNew
methods.description: Unit tests for creating new database store instances under various conditions.

methods.name: TestDatabaseStoreGet
methods.description: Tests for retrieving the current configuration from the database store.

methods.name: TestDatabaseStoreGetEnvironmentOverrides
methods.description: Tests for environment variable overrides affecting configuration retrieval.

methods.name: TestDatabaseStoreSet
methods.description: Tests for setting and persisting new configurations, including validation, cloning, and notification.

methods.name: TestDatabaseStoreLoad
methods.description: Tests for loading configurations from the database, respecting environment overrides and handling errors.

methods.name: TestDatabaseGetFile
methods.description: Tests for retrieving configuration files stored in the database.

methods.name: TestDatabaseSetFile
methods.description: Tests for adding and overwriting configuration files in the database.

methods.name: TestDatabaseHasFile
methods.description: Tests for checking existence of configuration files.

methods.name: TestDatabaseStoreString
methods.description: Tests for the string representation of the database connection, ensuring masking of sensitive info.

methods.name: TestCleanUp
methods.description: Tests for cleaning up old configurations, ensuring only recent and active configs remain.

search-terms: Go unit tests for config database
